question: Can frozen unsupervised region-family signatures recover mounted-versus-unowned visible board relations on later blind labels beyond whole-image DINOv3 and SigLIP 2?
hypothesis: Region-family presence/count/graph-strength features improve AUROC over the fused whole-image baseline because physical exposure and ownership depend on local part configuration rather than product appearance alone.
discovery_features: frozen r2 129-family assignments only; semantic names excluded from predictors
development_split: 130 resolved photos from earlier 136-photo board relation review; 13 mounted and 117 detached-or-multi-item; six unclear excluded
test_split: 48 resolved M/X photos from later blind review of 111 unique images; exact identities excluded from development; N and U excluded from the relation-only endpoint
source_control: phash<=5 candidate components define development CV groups and a test sensitivity excluding test members linked to development; list known incomplete
secondary_metrics: balanced accuracy at development OOF threshold
mounted found at equal review budget 10
model_selection: 5-fold stratified group CV on development only; C in [0.01,0.1,1,10]; fixed seed 20260928
uncertainty: 10000 stratified bootstrap replicates on blind test; paired AUROC deltas
falsification: No reliable gain over global_fused, or performance collapses after photo-group source control.
compute: local CPU/light RAM using frozen arrays; no GPU, downloads, or feature recomputation
locator_note: Input SHA-256 values identify exact bytes. Paths are portable cache locators; original execution receipts are preserved locally.
